summary: Andrew Lund, 22, of Branson, Missouri, disoriented in deep snow and cold near Lake Haiyaha/Chaos Canyon; found the next morning above Emerald Lake in the Tyndall Glacier area; led out to Bear Lake Trailhead and taken to Estes Park Medical Center.
location: Above Emerald Lake, Tyndall Glacier area, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park rangers | Larimer County Search and Rescue | Colorado Mountain School
notes: Incident date is date found/rescued: dropped at Bear Lake Trailhead Tue Oct 25; 911 call Wed Oct 26 8:30 a.m.; search by rangers, CMS, and Larimer County SAR; verbal contact 10:30 a.m. Thu Oct 27, reached 11:06 a.m.; helo gear drop west shore Emerald Lake; walked out to Bear Lake Trailhead 2:30 p.m.; transported to Estes Park Medical Center. Corroborated by NPS Morning Report (npshistory.com) entry of Friday, Oct 28, 2011.
